author: TON Core
description: Wallet V5 R1 is a TON wallet for holding GRAM and sending transactions; compared with V4, it uses app extensions instead of plugins.

fields.name: isSignatureAllowed
fields.description: Whether public-key signature authentication is currently allowed.

fields.name: seqno
fields.description: Replay-protection sequence number.

fields.name: subwalletId
fields.description: Wallet id, equivalent to subwallet id in earlier wallet versions.

fields.name: publicKey
fields.description: Stored Ed25519 public key used to verify signed requests.

fields.name: extensions
fields.description: Extension address-hash dictionary; keys are 256-bit address hashes in the wallet workchain.

declarations.name: WalletV5r1AddExtensionAction

fields.name: addr
fields.description: Internal address of the extension to add.

declarations.description: Extended action that installs an extension address.

declarations.name: WalletV5r1RemoveExtensionAction

fields.name: addr
fields.description: Internal address of the extension to remove.

declarations.description: Extended action that removes an installed extension address.

declarations.name: WalletV5r1SetSignatureAllowedAction

fields.name: allowSignature
fields.description: New signature-authentication mode.

declarations.description: Extended action that toggles public-key signature authentication.

declarations.name: WalletSignedInternalV5r1

fields.name: walletId
fields.description: Wallet id expected to match storage.subwalletId.

fields.name: validUntil
fields.description: Unix timestamp after which the request is expired.

fields.name: seqno
fields.description: Request sequence number expected to match storage.seqno.

fields.name: outActions
fields.description: Raw optional C5 out-action list cell.

fields.name: extendedActions
fields.description: Raw optional Wallet V5 extended-action list.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Ed25519 signature over the signed payload.

declarations.description: Internal signed request body, authenticated by Ed25519 signature.

declarations.name: WalletExtensionActionV5r1

fields.name: queryId
fields.description: Caller-selected query id for extension-originated requests.

fields.name: outActions
fields.description: Raw optional C5 out-action list cell.

fields.name: extendedActions
fields.description: Raw optional Wallet V5 extended-action list.

declarations.description: Internal extension request body, authenticated by the sender being installed.

declarations.name: WalletSignedExternalV5r1

fields.name: walletId
fields.description: Wallet id expected to match storage.subwalletId.

fields.name: validUntil
fields.description: Unix timestamp after which the request is expired.

fields.name: seqno
fields.description: Request sequence number expected to match storage.seqno.

fields.name: outActions
fields.description: Raw optional C5 out-action list cell.

fields.name: extendedActions
fields.description: Raw optional Wallet V5 extended-action list.

fields.name: signature
fields.description: Ed25519 signature over the signed payload.

declarations.description: External signed request body, authenticated by Ed25519 signature.

declarations.name: WalletV5r1IncomingExternalMessage
declarations.description: External-in message bodies accepted by Wallet V5 R1.

declarations.name: StonfiExcesses

fields.name: payload
fields.description: Protocol payload retained losslessly because its fields are not publicly specified.

declarations.description: STON.fi excess notification carried in a wallet-created self-message.

declarations.name: WalletV5r1OutgoingMessage
declarations.description: Application message bodies observed in Wallet V5 R1 action lists.

declarations.name: Errors

members.name: InvalidSeqno
members.description: Request seqno does not match storage.seqno.

members.name: InvalidWalletId
members.description: Request wallet id does not match storage.subwalletId.

members.name: Expired
members.description: Request validUntil is not greater than the current block time.

members.name: ExternalSendMessageMustHaveIgnoreErrorsSendMode
members.description: External request contains a send action without IGNORE_ERRORS send mode.

members.name: InvalidMessageOperation
members.description: Message opcode is not accepted in the current entrypoint.

members.name: AddExtension
members.description: Add-extension action failed, usually because the extension already exists.

members.name: RemoveExtension
members.description: Remove-extension action failed, usually because the extension does not exist.

members.name: DisableSignatureWhenExtensionsIsEmpty
members.description: Signature auth cannot be disabled while the extension dictionary is empty.

members.name: ThisSignatureModeAlreadySet
members.description: Requested signature-auth mode is already active.

members.name: RemoveLastExtensionWhenSignatureDisabled
members.description: The last extension cannot be removed while signature auth is disabled.

members.name: ExtensionWrongWorkchain
members.description: Extension address workchain differs from the wallet workchain.

members.name: OnlyExtensionCanChangeSignatureMode
members.description: Only an installed extension can change signature-auth mode.

declarations.description: Wallet V5 R1 exit-code catalog from the source implementation.

get_methods.name: seqno
get_methods.description: Return the current replay-protection sequence number.

get_methods.name: get_public_key
get_methods.description: Return the stored Ed25519 public key.

get_methods.name: get_subwallet_id
get_methods.description: Return the wallet id, equivalent to subwallet id.

get_methods.name: get_extensions
get_methods.description: Return the raw extension dictionary keyed by extension address hash.

get_methods.name: is_signature_allowed
get_methods.description: Return whether public-key signature authentication is currently allowed.
